items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: The governor. Our governor wrote that. Big Buck Blues. Which governor was this? Not so long. He was trying to get back to him. Jimmy Davis. Jimmy Davis.

ctx.x: I might have known him. I might have known him. He was out of Texas. You know who wrote the Big Buck Blues? Well I never have known. For sure I heard Lonnie Johnson.
The governor. Our governor wrote that. Big Buck Blues. Which governor was this? Not so long. He was trying to get back to him. Jimmy Davis. Jimmy Davis.
He wrote the Big Buck Blues. Did you know it was Stormy Weather?
